## About

Ghufron Ainun Najib is a full-stack developer based in Semarang, Indonesia. He studies Bachelor of Applied Science in Computer Engineering at Politeknik Negeri Semarang (Polines), expected graduation August 2028, GPA 3.91/4.00. Currently open to opportunities.

## Work Style

Backends that hold up, frontends that feel right. Comfortable owning a product end to end: architecture, APIs, edge deployment, and the tactile interfaces that ship them. Solo on most projects, team lead when the project needs one.

## Projects

### TempeMail (2026, solo)
Disposable email service running entirely on Cloudflare Workers. Multi-domain with auto-provisioning across 20+ domains, no VPS, no SMTP server. REST API, HMAC-signed webhook delivery, an MCP server for AI agents, and a dark-theme vanilla JS frontend with inbox search and API key management. 110 tests passing.
- Stack: TypeScript, Cloudflare Workers, D1, Hono
- Repo: https://github.com/Ghufrnainun/tempe-mail
- Live: https://temp.ghufronainun.tech

### Curated Design (2026, solo)
Curated directory of design resources for AI coding: component libraries, design systems, inspiration, dev tools, AI prompts — 292 resources across 5 categories with verified live links. Markdown-first pipeline so adding a resource is a one-line edit. CI deploy to Cloudflare Pages with unit tests for the parser and filter logic. Open contribution flow with PR templates and triage labels.
- Stack: React, Vite, Markdown, Cloudflare Pages, GitHub Actions
- Repo: https://github.com/Ghufrnainun/curated-design
- Live: https://design.ghuf.app

### SewaInAja (2026, full-stack, 4-person team)
Rental platform spanning a Flutter mobile experience and a Next.js 16 admin and API surface. Built customer-facing mobile flows, the administration and API surface with TypeScript 5, and integrated Firebase services and Midtrans payment handling. Delivered as a shared, publicly documented codebase.
- Stack: Flutter, Next.js 16, TypeScript 5, Firebase, Midtrans
- Repo: https://github.com/sewainaja-pbl

### LSP Polines Certification Platform (2025, team lead, 5-person team)
Certification website with ownership across team leadership, the authentication module, and Git workflow setup: repository rules, branching strategy, and a repeatable contribution workflow.
- Stack: Laravel, Livewire, Tailwind CSS, MySQL

### IMPP Organization Website (2025, solo)
Public website and CMS for Ikatan Mahasiswa Pemalang Polines: public-facing site plus a CMS for activities, structure, and gallery content.
- Stack: Laravel, MySQL, Tailwind CSS
